newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Two Costa Rica police officers jailed in drug case.
newsitem.headline: Two Costa Rica police officers jailed in drug case.

text.p: A judge has ordered two Costa Rican police officers arrested on suspicion of aiding a shipment of cocaine en route from Panama to Guatemala, judicial authorities said on Saturday.
A Supreme Court spokesman identified the two officers to reporters only by their surnames, Torres Almenjur and Rodriguez Baez.
The two were caught when Costa Rican authorities seized the 865 pound (393 kg) shipment of drugs in December.
Costa Rica also captured two Panamanians, a Colombian and four other Costa Ricans in connection with the case, confiscating money and jewels as well, authorities said.
